questions.q:
72 = 23 × 32 and 120 = 23 × 3 × 5
Find the highest common factor (HCF) of 72 and 120.
Find the lowest common multiple (LCM) of 72 and 120.
questions.ms: 360. M1 2³ × 3² × 5 (highest power of each prime), A1 360.

questions.q:
A red bus leaves the station every 12 minutes. A blue bus leaves the station every 18 minutes. Both buses leave the station at 9 am.
After how many minutes will both buses next leave the station at the same time?
questions.ms: 36 minutes (9:36 am). M1 list multiples or prime factors 12 = 2² × 3, 18 = 2 × 3², M1 LCM method, A1 36.
